items.title: 2. Number of Turns of the Coil

source_refs.note: 2. Number of Turns of the Coil: a main subheading of 10.8 Factors affecting emf, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 243-243.

blocks.text: According to Faraday's law, induced emf is also proportional to the number of turns of the coil. More turns result in a greater induced emf.
